exceptions.name: ForbiddenTransitionError
exceptions.trigger: Attempting an invalid state machine transition.
exceptions.rationale: State integrity violation; client logic error.

exceptions.name: ArtifactNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Core references a valid digest, but file is missing from disk.
exceptions.rationale: Logs warning and returns structurally safe domain error to caller instead of crashing.

exceptions.name: InvalidArtifactReferenceError
exceptions.trigger: Reference string fails regex or length validation before OS resolution.
exceptions.rationale: Pre-emptive security boundary check failed.

exceptions.name: ArtifactTamperedError
exceptions.trigger: Hash mismatch during read verification.
exceptions.rationale: Data integrity violation; must strictly block use of corrupted data.

exceptions.name: SecurityBoundaryError
exceptions.trigger: Path boundary violation or skill file byte count changing relative to its open-file size during digest computation.
exceptions.rationale: Strict security quarantine blocks execution.

exceptions.name: MissingDependencyError
exceptions.trigger: Dependency is absent, not ENABLED, or differs from an exact registered-version pin; boot also uses this failure path for a missing entrypoint.
exceptions.rationale: Enablement rejects unmet dependencies; boot reports failures and cascades FAILED states without aborting other discoveries.

exceptions.name: RegistrationConflictError
exceptions.trigger: Registration conflicts with an in-memory manifest or disk manifest version differs from the registered version.
exceptions.rationale: Registered version identity is not silently replaced.

exceptions.name: DowngradeNotSupportedError
exceptions.trigger: Schema version loaded is older than DB version.
exceptions.rationale: Prevents data corruption from legacy code schemas.

exceptions.name: MemoryError
exceptions.trigger: Loading artifact payload into memory.
exceptions.rationale: Stream chunking mechanism avoids OOM natively.

exceptions.name: IOError_ENOSPC
exceptions.trigger: Disk full during staging.
exceptions.rationale: Atomic write fails gracefully, staging file aggressively removed.

exceptions.name: PartialReadError
exceptions.trigger: Stream read interrupted.
exceptions.rationale: Aborts staging before digestion; temp file swept.

exceptions.name: SchemaValidationError
exceptions.trigger: Extension manifest is structurally malformed.
exceptions.rationale: Strict JSON schema Draft 2020-12 enforcement.

exceptions.name: TypeMismatchError
exceptions.trigger: Manifest uses null instead of strictly typed string.
exceptions.rationale: Strict typing constraint failure.

exceptions.name: ExtensionHookError
exceptions.trigger: Entrypoint is missing during enablement or entrypoint execution raises.
exceptions.rationale: Failed enablement does not leave a newly discovered extension ENABLED without its runtime module. Dispatch hook failures are caught directly and mark FAILED.

exceptions.name: FileExistsError
exceptions.trigger: Commit publication encounters a concurrent existing destination.
exceptions.rationale: An existing regular destination is success only after full streamed digest verification; absence or corruption is not deduplication success.

exceptions.name: SQLiteBusyError
exceptions.trigger: Concurrent write lock during migration.
exceptions.rationale: Driver retry timeout fences reads and eventually resolves.

exceptions.name: CorruptMetadataError
exceptions.trigger: DB artifact record is missing or garbled.
exceptions.rationale: State is recoverable via physical payload cryptographic hashing.

exceptions.name: WindowsJunctionError
exceptions.trigger: Reparse point detected in payload path.
exceptions.rationale: Windows-specific security rule enforcement.

exceptions.name: UnicodeNormalizationError
exceptions.trigger: NFC/NFD confusion in path string.
exceptions.rationale: Not applicable; system strictly uses ASCII hex digests.

exceptions.name: NULByteError
exceptions.trigger: NUL byte in path reference string.
exceptions.rationale: Pre-OS regex validation catches before triggering OS ValueError.

exceptions.name: ReservedDeviceNameError
exceptions.trigger: Path attempts to use CON, NUL, PRN.
exceptions.rationale: Windows OS constraint bypassed safely via application-level regex.

exceptions.name: PathTooLongError
exceptions.trigger: Exceeding 260 chars MAX_PATH on Windows.
exceptions.rationale: System uses Windows `\\?\` long path prefix natively.

exceptions.name: OrphanGarbageCollectionError
exceptions.trigger: Attempting to GC file currently locked by OS read.
exceptions.rationale: Windows mandatory file lock prevents GC; deferred to next cycle.

exceptions.name: MigrationCrashError
exceptions.trigger: Process forcefully dies mid-migration.
exceptions.rationale: SQLite WAL rollback ensures state consistency on subsequent boot.

exceptions.name: HostileSymlinkError
exceptions.trigger: Payload is a symlink pointing out of bounds.
exceptions.rationale: Hostile Boundary enforcement.

exceptions.name: ZeroByteOverwriteError
exceptions.trigger: Tampered file manually truncated to 0 bytes.
exceptions.rationale: Read-time size check catches before hash stream executes.

exceptions.name: DuplicateCommitIdempotencyTrigger
exceptions.trigger: Commit finds an existing digest-addressed blob.
exceptions.rationale: Stream-verifies the existing blob, refreshes its modification time for GC grace, and removes redundant staging.

exceptions.name: ConcurrentStagingCollision
exceptions.trigger: Two processes write to identical temporary name.
exceptions.rationale: mkstemp uniqueness guarantees disjoint writes by suffix.

exceptions.name: AtomicRenameCrashError
exceptions.trigger: Power loss during commit.
exceptions.rationale: Leaves `.tmp` file which Boot GC sweeps cleanly.

exceptions.name: EmptyArtifactError
exceptions.trigger: Zero-byte payload submitted.
exceptions.rationale: Perfectly valid; hashed to known e3b0c442... digest.

exceptions.name: WorkRevisionConflictError
exceptions.trigger: Expected revision differs from authoritative Record-derived revision, append conflicts, or the reducer does not accept the caller's mutation Record.
exceptions.rationale: A stale cache or successful append cannot acknowledge a losing mutation.

exceptions.name: WorkNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Referenced work_id does not exist in projection or stream.
exceptions.rationale: Unknown work entity reference.

exceptions.name: InvalidWorkPayloadError
exceptions.trigger: Work creation or transition payload fails schema constraints.
exceptions.rationale: Pre-emptive validation rejection.

exceptions.name: WorkAlreadyExistsError
exceptions.trigger: Creation finds an existing projection row, or authoritative creation recovery finds conflicting stream/content or an advanced revision.
exceptions.rationale: Identical creation-crash recovery is permitted only with a missing projection row and authoritative revision 1.

exceptions.name: SkillNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Referenced skill_id does not exist in registry or index.
exceptions.rationale: Unknown skill reference.

exceptions.name: SkillManifestError
exceptions.trigger: SKILL.md frontmatter is missing, unparseable, or fails schema validation.
exceptions.rationale: Schema validation boundary violation.

exceptions.name: SkillTamperedError
exceptions.trigger: Current directory digest differs from the recorded skill digest.
exceptions.rationale: Record-only rebuild preserves the recorded digest and cannot authorize disk drift.

exceptions.name: UnauthorizedSkillError
exceptions.trigger: Attempt to invoke, execute, or select an inactive or suspended skill.
exceptions.rationale: Discovery != authorization invariant.

exceptions.name: VolatileFactRejectedError
exceptions.trigger: Attempt to register volatile runtime measurement into curated capability catalog.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 9: Volatile measured facts stay in M1 Observation/Diag.

exceptions.name: EvalDatasetNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Referenced eval dataset or artifact digest does not exist.
exceptions.rationale: Unknown dataset reference.

exceptions.name: EvaluatorExecutionError
exceptions.trigger: Evaluator execution failed or crashed unexpectedly.
exceptions.rationale: Runtime execution exception inside evaluator logic.

exceptions.name: EvalReportTamperedError
exceptions.trigger: Eval report contents do not match calculated verification digest.
exceptions.rationale: Integrity check failed on stored evaluation report.

exceptions.name: TelemetryExportError
exceptions.trigger: Telemetry exporter sink failed to write or export events.
exceptions.rationale: Failure isolation ensures core storage and stream transactions are never impacted.

exceptions.name: EvalTruthViolationError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to use evaluation result or telemetry as authoritative collaboration truth.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 12: Eval/Telemetry never becomes collaboration truth.

exceptions.name: EvaluatorValidationError
exceptions.trigger: Evaluator missing required metadata (type, version) or produces invalid score types.
exceptions.rationale: Deterministic evaluator contract violation.

exceptions.name: BackupCorruptedError
exceptions.trigger: File checksum mismatch or archive corruption detected in backup bundle.
exceptions.rationale: Cryptographic verification failure prevents corrupted state restoration.

exceptions.name: BackupManifestMissingError
exceptions.trigger: backup_manifest.json is missing; an unparsable manifest raises BackupCorruptedError, and restore's initial read lets filesystem errors (PermissionError/OSError) propagate.
exceptions.rationale: Proof-of-backup manifest is strictly required.

exceptions.name: GenerationFencingConflictError
exceptions.trigger: An existing workspace database fails the idle checkpoint check, or an older backup is restored with allow_rollback=False.
exceptions.rationale: Offline replacement rejects detected busy databases; rollback is otherwise allowed by default.

exceptions.name: AuthoritativeRestoreOrderError
exceptions.trigger: Authoritative database is unavailable, or authoritative replay/projection-port delegation fails.
exceptions.rationale: Derived rebuild requires existing authority and delegates through the supplied projection port.

exceptions.name: SecretLeakageDetectedError
exceptions.trigger: Unmasked secret or credential key found inside backup bundle.
exceptions.rationale: Secrets are excluded by default from backup bundles.

exceptions.name: MCPDirectStorageAccessError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted direct storage or database write bypassing public core and extension ports.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 10: MCP never writes storage directly.

exceptions.name: MCPProtocolError
exceptions.trigger: Malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 framing or protocol message syntax.
exceptions.rationale: Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol validation.

exceptions.name: MCPMethodNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Requested MCP tool, resource, or prompt method is not registered.
exceptions.rationale: Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 method not found (-32601).

exceptions.name: MCPInvalidParamsError
exceptions.trigger: MCP tool or resource arguments failed validation against expected schema.
exceptions.rationale: Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 invalid parameters (-32602).

exceptions.name: MCPSessionInvalidError
exceptions.trigger: Session handle is unauthenticated, expired, or invalid for sensitive MCP operations.
exceptions.rationale: Explicit session handle isolation per invocation.

exceptions.name: SkillRevisionConflictError
exceptions.trigger: Authoritative skill revision conflicts, append conflicts, mutation loses reducer acceptance, or re-indexing conflicts with registered identity.
exceptions.rationale: Ordered Records determine accepted lifecycle changes.

exceptions.name: CapabilityConflictError
exceptions.trigger: Authoritative capability revision conflicts, append conflicts, mutation loses reducer acceptance, or declaration conflicts with existing stream/specification/revision.
exceptions.rationale: Cached rows cannot authorize stale or conflicting catalog writes.

exceptions.name: ValueError
exceptions.trigger: Artifact stream exceeds max_size, staging arguments are invalid, or orphan-GC min_age_seconds is negative.
exceptions.rationale: Invalid bounds fail explicitly; oversize staging removes its temporary file.

exceptions.name: EvalSourceMismatchError
exceptions.trigger: Trace/dataset digest or count mismatches content, optional dataset artifact verification fails, report source bindings differ, or evaluator snapshots fail post-execution source verification.
exceptions.rationale: A report must bind the content actually evaluated.
